value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: In 2012, Brock Rumlow's STRIKE team collects Loki's scepter at Stark Tower for Alexander Pierce, to take to Dr. List.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Pierce's STRIKE leader, who collects Loki's scepter for him in 2012.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA boss Rumlow collects Loki's scepter for in 2012.

verdicts.why: Rumlow leads the STRIKE team taking the scepter for Pierce (Sitwell reports to 'Mr. Secretary' with Rumlow there; Rumlow refuses Steve's claim that the Secretary sent him), but they never get it out of Stark Tower: Steve takes it from Rumlow in the elevator.

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: In 2012, Jack Rollins rides the Stark Tower elevator with the STRIKE team taking Loki's scepter to HYDRA for Alexander Pierce.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A STRIKE agent taking Loki's scepter to HYDRA for Pierce in 2012.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA boss Rollins's team takes Loki's scepter for in 2012.

verdicts.why: Rollins is with STRIKE taking the scepter for Pierce's operation, but they never ride out of Stark Tower with it: Steve tricks them out of it in the elevator.

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: In 2012, Jasper Sitwell collects Loki's scepter at Stark Tower and calls Alexander Pierce from the elevator to report it secure and on its way to Dr. List.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Calls Pierce in 2012 to report Loki's scepter secure.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The boss Sitwell reports to about Loki's scepter in 2012.

verdicts.why: The call to Pierce ('Evidence secure... Mr. Secretary') is right, but Sitwell never takes the scepter out of Stark Tower; he collects it from Natasha and loses it to Steve in the elevator.
Rollins rides the elevator with Rumlow's STRIKE team carrying the scepter until Steve's 'Hail Hydra' gets them to hand it over.

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: In 2012, Natasha hands Loki's scepter over to the STRIKE team and warns them to be careful with it. Rumlow promises they will, as the team takes it away for HYDRA.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Hands Rumlow Loki's scepter in 2012 with a warning.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Takes Loki's scepter from Natasha in 2012, meant for HYDRA.

verdicts.why: Natasha does hand the scepter to STRIKE ('Careful with that thing'; Rumlow: 'We promise to be careful'), but they never take it to HYDRA: Steve gets it from Rumlow in the elevator.
Bruce and Rocket go to New Asgard, find the drinking Thor and talk him into joining the plan.
At the New Asgard docks Valkyrie greets Bruce ('I think I liked you better either of the other ways'), warns Thor won't see them and directs them to his house.
The 2012 Hulk's burst through the door knocks the Tesseract to Loki by accident; the two never deal with each other there.
At the funeral Sam puts a comforting hand on Bucky's shoulder; at the lake Bucky beckons Sam over to the aged Steve, who passes Sam the shield.
After Peter hands Carol the gauntlet, Valkyrie is among the heroes who rally around her and clear her path toward the van.
Scott says 'I'm not ready for this' and Clint ('I'm game. I'll do it.') takes his place in the test run; both then go on the time heist.
Clint plans the time heist with Steve and the others, mourns Natasha with the original Avengers, and asks 'Cap' what to do with the gauntlet.
After Vormir Thor insists Natasha can be brought back and Clint shouts that 'It can't be undone'.
At the funeral Clint wishes he could let Natasha know they won and Wanda answers 'She knows. They both do.'
Carol and Fury are both at Tony's funeral but no exchange between them is shown.
The 2014 Cull knocks Tony over and tries to stab him with a hidden blade until Peter webs him off his feet.
The 2014 Maw restrains T'Challa and nearly takes the gauntlet before Peter takes it from his reach.
In 1970 Howard leaves Camp Lehigh with Jarvis and asks 'Jarvis, have we ever met that guy?'; Jarvis: 'You meet a lot of people, sir.'
Drax and Groot leave with the Guardians on the Benatar; after Drax suggests Quill and Thor fight for the lead, Groot chimes in ('I am Groot').
Drax and Mantis arrive through the Titan portal together, and on the Benatar Mantis backs the fight Drax suggests ('Oh, yes, please use knives').
They come through the Titan portal together, and Drax tells Quill and Thor 'You should fight one another for the honor of leadership.'
On the Benatar, after Drax's suggestion, Rocket offers 'some blasters unless you guys want to use knives'.
On the Benatar Drax says Quill and Thor should fight for leadership and Nebula answers 'Sounds fair.'
Strange opens the portal from Titan and comes through it with Drax, Mantis and Quill to join the battle.
Tony's snap wipes out Thanos's whole army, Maw among them, but the two never deal with each other in Endgame; a mass wipe is the shared battle, not an exchange.
Corvus relays Thanos's order for a general bombardment of the field and protests it; he never faces or targets Wanda, so it is Thanos's act in a shared battle.

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: Steve Rogers, back in 2012 from the future, steps into a Stark Tower elevator with Rollins and the rest of the STRIKE team and fakes being HYDRA to trick them into handing over Loki's scepter.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Captain America from the future, who tricks Rollins out of the scepter.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A HYDRA agent Steve tricks out of the scepter in 2012 with a whispered "Hail Hydra."

verdicts.why: Steve does trick the STRIKE team in the elevator, but Rollins is not their leader (Rumlow and Sitwell lead) and the whispered 'Hail Hydra' goes to Sitwell.
Rhodes and Rogers are among the surviving Avengers, plan the time heist together and both fight in the battle against the 2014 Thanos's forces.
On the Benatar Groot ('I am Groot') is for knives and Thor answers 'There shall be no knifing one another.'
On the Benatar Groot's 'I am Groot' is answered by Quill's 'Not necessary!'

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: Nebula rejoins the Guardians aboard the Benatar with Groot. When Drax says Quill and Thor should fight for the lead, she agrees and Groot wants knives.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow Guardian who sets off into space with Groot after the battle.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian she sets off into space with after the battle.

verdicts.why: They are on the Benatar together, but it is Drax who suggests the fight; Nebula only agrees ('Sounds fair').
Happy watches Tony's recording with Pepper and Morgan at the lake house, then sits with Morgan and promises her cheeseburgers.
Sitwell: 'We can take that off your hands.' Natasha: 'By all means. Careful with that thing.'
In the elevator Sitwell wants to call the Director, Steve whispers 'Hail Hydra' to him, and Sitwell lets him take the scepter.
Korg and Miek live at Thor's in New Asgard when Bruce and Rocket arrive, and Miek fights alongside Korg in the Battle of Earth.
